name: preset-kit
description: Preset Kit build and validation tools

scripts.check: npm run test && npm run check:substore && npm run check:rules && npm run check:ini && npm run check:configs && npm run lint:rules -- --strict && npm run check:rename-dict

scripts.refresh:all: npm run build:substore && npm run refresh:ini && npm run build:configs
